The [[Rutian]] [[Twi'lek]] [[Gender|female]] was an '''individual''' [[Slavery|enslaved]] to fellow Twi'lek<ref name="Rescue" /> male<ref name="Bib Databank">{{Databank|bib-fortuna|Bib Fortuna}}</ref> [[Bib Fortuna]], an ex<ref name="Rescue" />-[[majordomo]]<ref name="Bib Databank" /> who had assumed the [[Jabba the Hutt's dais|throne]] of his late master, the crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="Storm">{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}}</ref> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Attack on Jabba's Palace (Boba Fett)|attack on Jabba's Palace]], depicted in "[[Chapter 16: The Rescue]]," is dated by "[[Jabba the Hutt and Other Characters of the Underworld]]" to be around [[9 ABY]].</ref> she was present with Fortuna in his [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] when it was [[Attack on Jabba's Palace (Boba Fett)|attacked]] by<ref name="Rescue" /> the ex-[[bounty hunter]]<ref name="Storm" /> [[Boba Fett]] and his accomplice, the [[assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]]. Shand [[Death|shot down]] numerous denizens and guards of the palace, prompting the Twi'lek slave to attempt to free herself by tugging on her chain which connected her to her Fortuna's throne. Shand then shot the slave's chain with her [[blaster rifle]] and gestured the Twi'lek to flee the throne room. Shortly after, Fortuna was killed by Fett, who assumed Fortuna's [[throne]]. The Twi'lek had [[Color|blue]] skin and black [[eye]]s, wearing black [[clothing]] with a midriff and head covering. She wore several pieces of jewelry including a necklace, bracelets and anklets, a shackle on her right ankle with a chain attached, and she was barefoot.<ref name="Rescue" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Super grateful to be a very small part of the Star Wars universe.|Rachel McDermott, on being a part of "Chapter 16: The Rescue"|<ref name="Instagram">{{Instagram|username=rachelmcdermott|url=p/CI9M5Gapm-8|name=[[Rachel McDermott]]|archivefile=File:RachelMcDermott-Chapter16-Slave.png}}</ref>}}
The Twi'lek appeared in "[[Chapter 16: The Rescue]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Peyton Reed]]<ref name="Rescue" /> and released on [[December 18]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}}</ref> The character was played by an uncredited [[Rachel McDermott]].<ref name="Instagram" />
